summary: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, solely to announce its first quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing reports Q1 total revenues of $149.4 million, net income of $63.7 million, and cash of $755.9 million with no funded debt. There is no mention of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine earnings update with no event-driven corporate action.
